task: predict real-time crash likelihood on freeways
note: Crash detection rate coded as recall, false alarm rate as specificity. Loop detector traffic plus web weather data; random forest used only for variable selection; matched case-control design.

task: classify sentiment of tweets about electric vehicles
note: Three-class sentiment (1818 neutral, 870 positive, 490 negative tweets). The abstract does not describe the evaluation design.

task: classify cancer from microarray gene expression
note: Discriminative deep belief network compared with SVM; information gain gene selection plus SMOTE. Framed as cancer diagnosis, so medicine rather than bio (borderline). Evaluation design not stated.

task: classify sleep stages from polysomnography
note: Oversampling by overlapping sliding windows, described as data augmentation; no SMOTE. Coded as standard augmentation under B2 although presented as the paper's framework. EEG/EOG turned into CWT spectrograms for AlexNet, AlexNet+SVM, ResNet-18.

task: classify sentiment of tweets about Islamophobia after the Christchurch attack
note: Tweets labelled automatically with VADER. The abstract names no measure, only an unspecified 'performance value' and processing time; evaluation design not stated.

task: detect network intrusions
note: Hybrid sampling SMOTE plus Neighborhood Cleaning Rule, not compared with other resampling in the abstract (rule B). DBN for dimension reduction, PNN classifier, NSL-KDD; detection rate coded as recall.

task: na
note: No domain application: an existing SMOTE variant (Random-SMOTE) with logit on five UCI benchmark data sets only, i.e. a method demonstration on benchmarks.

task: predict MOOC learners' employment status from their written texts
note: The 'widely used oversampling method' is not named (coded other); generative paraphrasing coded deep-generative, a standard generator under B2 (type not stated). Stakes: profiles feed personalised recommendations to learners.

task: predict successful extubation in mechanically ventilated ICU patients
note: 233 patients, 28 failed extubation; 10-fold cross-validation. Abstract says RF results on the original and SMOTE data sets differed little. Features from time-series ventilator parameters.

task: predict presence of major depressive disorder
note: Public anonymised depression data set; RFECV used for feature selection, but the abstract does not state how the reported metrics were validated. Best model logistic regression.

task: detect mental stress state (baseline, stress, amusement) from ECG and GSR
note: WESAD data; wavelet packet features, extremely randomized trees for feature selection, ADASYN then multi-class RF. The 'new technique' is the pipeline, not the resampler. Evaluation design not stated.

task: predict bankruptcy
note: The oversampling method is not named in the abstract (coded other). Whether firms or persons go bankrupt is not stated; coded stakes other on the usual corporate reading, uncertain.

task: detect early faults in vacuum ion pumps from pressure data
note: European XFEL pump pressure data; SVM and CNN. Abstract says cost-sensitive learning was investigated alongside SMOTE (relevant to vs_weights if the full text is checked). Evaluation design not stated.

task: classify whether a patient has malaria
note: Abstract itself states the 70/30 train/test split was drawn from the SMOTE-balanced data (resampling before split, balanced test), but FT fields are na per codebook. 165 patients; Weka vs R.

task: diagnose polycystic ovary syndrome
note: Kaggle PCOS data set; SMOTE then correlation-based feature selection; RF chosen for the diagnostic system. Evaluation design not stated.

task: detect fraudulent motor insurance claims
note: Abstract names no measure. Compared with the imbalanced data and other existing methods. Stakes individual because a flag decides on an insured person's claim.

task: diagnose and forecast faults in industrial systems (wind turbines, PHM 2015)
note: Easy-SMT = SMOTE plus EasyEnsemble, presented as the contribution but compared only with baseline classifiers (rule B: existing parts). Third place in a wind turbine failure challenge (held-out test). Abstract names no measure.

task: classify retinal microaneurysm candidates as true or false
note: BSMOTE-Tomek and BSMOTE-ENN presented as new but built from existing parts, no stated comparison with other resampling (rule B). Hybrids coded to nearest codes. ROC and FROC curves (FROC as other).

task: predict breast cancer occurrence from risk factors
note: BCSC data; SMOTE, SpreadSubsample and their hybrid compared. Abstract says balancing was applied to the data set before building learners; best method tested on validation data. Bayesian network coded other.

task: classify the polarity of citation sentences
note: TF-IDF uni-/bi-grams, experiments with and without SMOTE; best result extra trees on SMOTE data. Other classifiers are not named in the abstract. Bibliometric text coded social.

task: detect and classify faults in transmission lines connected to inverter-based generators
note: Simulated PV and DFIG systems; abstract reports specificity unbalanced vs SMOTE-balanced. Best models 'further tested using a new dataset test case', coded external (simulated data, could be read as internal). Bagged and AdaBoost tree ensembles.

task: detect vulnerabilities in Ethereum smart contract code
note: The 'over-sampling techniques' are not named (coded other). Eight fine-tuned transformer encoders on three Solidity data sets; source code treated as text. Domain could also be software.

task: na
note: No domain application: proposes a combination of SMOTE and complementary neural network for imbalanced data, evaluated with ANN, kNN and SVM on UCI benchmark data sets only.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: Ukrainian paper. Random undersampling and SMOTE; LR best on training and cross-validation sets; one-hidden-layer NNs compared on under- vs oversampled data. 'Precision-Recall indicator' coded PR-AUC.

task: detect rare high-risk cases in non-invasive prenatal testing data
note: Cost-sensitive XGBoost framework: instance cost weights, threshold tuned on a validation set, plus unnamed 'moderate oversampling' (coded other). Real NIPT data. Abstract names no specific measure.

task: na
note: Abstract mentions no resampling, only that the fraud data are imbalanced (MLP and 1D-CNN-LSTM fraud detection). Coded no as resampling is not shown; the full text may use it.

task: predict pipe failure vulnerability in a district heating network
note: The oversampling strategies and the ML algorithm are not named (coded other). AUC seems to be the area under fault-capture vs length-capture curves (coded other). Danish network (HOFOR); district heating coded energy, could be industry.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: Standard VAE used as oversampler with no stated change (B2: application), compared with SMOTE and GAN-based oversampling. European cardholder data (September 2013).

task: recognise facial expressions in images
note: Oversampling for RAF-DB imbalance is not named (coded other); augmentation on CK+ only to enlarge data, not counted. Model-averaging ensemble of fine-tuned CNNs; test accuracy on FER-2013, CK+, RAF-DB.

task: detect injurious patient-ventilator asynchrony from ventilator waveforms
note: Breaths from 35 patients; double trigger and breath stacking asynchrony. Ensemble classifier type not named (coded other). Validation design not stated in the abstract despite 'generalizable' in title.

task: classify programmers' personality types from continuous-integration logs
note: Title says 'novel SMOTE algorithm' but the abstract describes adopting standard SMOTE, no change stated, as the core innovation; coded existing. Learner not named; abstract names no measure. Modality of log data uncertain.

task: na
note: No domain application: a general imbalanced-classification method combining over- and undersampling with twin SVM; no domain or data set named, compared with state-of-the-art methods.

task: classify students' text feedback
note: Three student feedback text data sets (ASS, FDS, NASS); recall gains reported relative to no SMOTE. Classifiers not named (coded other); evaluation design not stated.

task: predict node failures and failure types in cloud data centers
note: SCS-XGBoost integrates unnamed oversampling (coded other) with cost-sensitive learning; HW-GRU and CNN extract temporal and spatial features. Contribution is the failure predictor, not the resampler. No measure named.

task: predict defective software modules
note: Pi Sigma neural network on five NASA PROMISE defect data sets; min-max normalisation, SMOTE, correlation thresholds for feature reduction. Validation design not stated.

task: predict depression risk in hepatitis B patients
note: NHANES data; standardisation then SMOTE, RF feature screening (top 20). Calibration curves and decision curve analysis named in the abstract (calibration field na without full text). LDA coded other.

task: predict defibrillation success from the pre-shock VF ECG in cardiac arrest
note: Raw 4 s VF episodes into a CNN with MLP head; 10-fold cross-validation, SMOTE on the minority class (relation to folds not stated in the abstract). Learned vs hand-crafted features on the same data.

task: predict daily crash occurrence and severe crashes on rural interstates
note: Texas rural interstate daily crash data with geometry, speed and weather; XGBoost best, SHAP for explanation. Abstract names no measure and no evaluation design.

task: predict student dropout
note: Synthetic data from a VAE combined with ADASYN (standard generator, no stated change: B2) compared with a weighted loss; best results came from the original data without oversampling. Multivariate sequential student records.

task: predict defective software modules
note: PROMISE defect data; CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM, SVM, RF with SMOTE; CatBoost and RF best. Abstract names no measure and no evaluation design.

task: classify lithium concentration viability in oilfield produced waters
note: USGS produced-water data, log transform and SMOTE; three viability classes; cross-validation plus external validation on an independent Jianghan Basin (Qianjiang Formation) data set. Earth-resource task coded environment.

task: na
note: No domain application: a general algorithm (k-means cluster undersampling plus SMOTE with a cost-sensitive modified AdaBoost) for imbalanced data; no domain or data set named.

task: predict patient mortality in the emergency department
note: SMOTE, ADASYN, CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, Gaussian Copula (copula coded other), all standard (B2); best Gaussian Copula + CatBoost. 7325 ED patients, PITA features. Accuracy named only as misleading, not coded.

task: detect cyberattacks in industrial IoT network traffic
note: ToN_IoT data, binary and multi-class; SVD feature reduction then SMOTE. ML and DL classifiers not named (deep-net from the title, rest other). Error rate is the complement of accuracy.

task: identify coal pay zones from drilling and logging-while-drilling data
note: Six Surat Basin wells; NROS and SMOTE each coupled with LR, SVM, ANN, RF, XGBoost. Multi-well experiments train on nearby wells and predict a new well (coded external, another site). Geology task coded environment.

task: classify road traffic incident tweets into five classes
note: Thai tweets; undersampling, unnamed oversampling and Markov-chain text generation (both coded other) studied; Bi-LSTM best vs Markov-chain baseline. Domain could be social (Twitter text).

task: classify bottomonium states in particle physics data
note: Upsilon(1S, 2S, 3S) states; five 'widely used' oversamplers and two hybrids with RF, plus class-weighted RF compared. Only SMOTETomek is named (the rest coded other). Physics coded other.

task: classify prospective Hajj pilgrims' health capability (istitaah) from EHR
note: EHR of prospective pilgrims in Purworejo, used for training and testing. SMOTE (data approach) compared with an unspecified algorithmic approach; SMOTE plus neural network best.

task: give early warning of carbon price volatility risk
note: No abstract; coded from the title only. 'Improved' qualifies the SVM classifier; the oversampling technique is unnamed (coded other). Multifractal singularity spectrum features of carbon prices.

task: classify breast thermograms for breast cancer detection
note: Preprocessing module (standardisation, SMOTE, undersampling) presented as the contribution; per-step effects read as an ablation, not a comparison with other resampling (rule B), so application. Classifier not named.

task: detect dental diseases on panoramic X-ray images
note: IDD-Net CNN compared with AlexNet, InceptionResNet-V2, Xception and MobileNet-V2; SMOTE-Tomek used to balance the image classes. Evaluation design not stated.

task: detect network intrusions
note: SMOTE with CNN plus BiLSTM on CIC-IDS2017, NSL-KDD and UNSW-NB15; compared with state-of-the-art models. Abstract names no measure and no evaluation design.
